newsitem.title: FINLAND: PARTEK SELLS UNIT TO NATSTEEL.
newsitem.headline: PARTEK SELLS UNIT TO NATSTEEL.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and building materials group Partek Oy Ab said on Tuesday it had sold its 45 percent stake in precast concrete, plaster and mortar maker Eastern Partek Pte Ltd to NatSteel of Singapore.
"The proceeds of the transaction will amount to 190 million markka on which Partek will realize a profit of FIM 90 million," Partek said in a statement.
The buyer was NatSteel's wholly-owned Singapore-based subsidiary Eastern Industries Pte. Ltd., Partek said.
Eastern Partek was established in 1982 as a joint venture between Partek and Eastern Industries and it had net sales of 316 million markka in 1996, Partek said.
It operates in Singapore, Malaysia and Taiwan, Partek said.
The sale was in line with Partek's previously announced strategy to focus on its engineering and materials handling operations and to make its precast concrete operations independent, Partek said.

"Partek's focus in Asia will be on its material-handling businesses," it said, adding that Asia accounts for about four percent of Partek group net sales and about 16 percent of the net sales of its its materials handling business area.
